_schema_note: Ruleset Store DB records — record_type: add_on_item. Each entry is a separate DB record. The MCP Server filters this catalog by patient gender and age at query time before returning add_on_library[] in get_program_ruleset().
_version_note: Draft v2026.03.1-draft — for clinical expert verification. All items require MAT validation before status is set to 'active'.
_framework_reference: rule-synthesis-framework.md §6 (Derivation Ledger). All signal_ids trace to signal-store-contract.md Field Dictionary. All clinical claims trace to clinical-guidelines-reference.md.
_option_a_symptom_signals: Signals prefixed symptom_ (symptom_palpitations, symptom_chronic_back_pain, symptom_unexplained_weight_loss, symptom_chest_pain, symptom_dyspnea_on_exertion) are first-class signal IDs per Option A. They must be added to signal-store-contract.md Field Dictionary and populated by the Clinical Signal Engine from symptom_tags[].
_expert_review_instructions: For each item please verify: (1) trigger_signals — are these the right clinical signals to activate this add-on? (2) priority_level_default — is this the right urgency level? (3) age_min / age_max — do these match current guideline age eligibility? (4) gender_constraint — is this correctly restricted or open? (5) Are there any missing add-ons for the Thai/Navavej patient population not covered here?

items.label: Colonoscopy — Colorectal Cancer Screening

priority_override_signals._note: Red regardless of overdue days when first-degree relative had CRC. Default Red because screening interval is 10 years — any overdue = ≥ 10yr gap.

navavej_product.note: OQ-7: Standalone colonoscopy (lower GI) availability unconfirmed — may require separate product code. Upper GI endoscopy used as placeholder.

items.guideline: USPSTF Colorectal Cancer Screening 2021 — Grade A (age 45–75), SDM 76–85, not recommended > 85
items._guideline_age_note: USPSTF 2021 lowered start age from 50 → 45. Verify hospital has adopted this update.

items.label: Exercise Stress Test (EST) — Treadmill ECG
items._safety_note: EST is absolutely contraindicated during hypertensive crisis (SBP > 180 or DBP > 120) per AHA/ACC 2002. Also contraindicated during active hypoglycemia.
items.guideline: AHA/ACC Exercise Testing Guidelines 2002; ADA Standards of Medical Care 2024 — DM + age > 40 + ≥ 2 CV risk factors

items.label: Echocardiogram (ECHO) — Cardiac Ultrasound
items.guideline: Clinical practice; ADA Standards 2024 — DM cardiovascular organ complication surveillance; ACC/AHA HTN guidelines
items._expert_review_note: Is age 35 the right lower bound for ECHO? Should it be higher (e.g., 40) or triggered only when DM/HTN comorbidity is active regardless of age?

items.label: CT Coronary Artery Calcium Scoring (CAC)
items._safety_note: CT-CAC uses non-contrast CT; iodinated contrast not required. However, if hospital protocol uses contrast enhancement, apply eGFR < 30 restriction.
items.guideline: ACC/AHA Cholesterol Guideline 2018 — CAC scoring as risk-decision aid when statin decision is uncertain in intermediate-risk patients
items._expert_review_note: ACC/AHA 2018 positions CAC as a risk-refinement tool when the decision to start statin therapy is uncertain (borderline-intermediate risk). Is it appropriate to recommend CAC for all patients with family_hx_premature_cad, or only when lipid treatment decision is unclear?

items.label: 48-Hour Cardiac Patch Monitor (Arrhythmia Screening)
items._symptom_signal_note: Uses Option A symptom signals — must be in signal-store-contract.md Field Dictionary.
items.guideline: Clinical practice — palpitations / chest pain / dyspnea on exertion workup for arrhythmia evaluation

items.label: Low-Dose CT Chest — Lung Cancer Annual Screening
items._priority_rationale: Red: USPSTF Grade B — annual screening indicated for eligible patients. High-severity oncologic risk. Never-screened eligible patient = highest urgency.

navavej_product.product_name: Low-Dose CT Chest (Lung Cancer / PM2.5 Screening)

items.guideline: USPSTF Lung Cancer Screening 2021 — Grade B: age 50–80, ≥ 20 pack-years, current smoker or quit within past 15 years
items._guideline_age_note: USPSTF 2021 changed criteria: age 50–80 (previously 55–80), pack-years ≥ 20 (previously ≥ 30). Verify this updated threshold is adopted.

items.label: Mammogram — Bilateral Screening Mammography
items._priority_rationale: Red: Biennial interval is 24 months. Any overdue = ≥ 24+ months gap. Family history further elevates to annual.
items.guideline: USPSTF Breast Cancer Screening 2024 — Grade B: biennial mammography ages 40–74; ACS 2023: annual 45–54, biennial 55+
items._guideline_note: USPSTF 2024 updated start age from 50 → 40. ACS recommends annual from 45. System uses USPSTF 2024 biennial from 40 as primary rule. ACS annual is acceptable alternative — confirm with hospital protocol.
items._expert_review_note: Should the high-risk interval (annual, for BRCA/family hx) produce a different item_code to distinguish from standard biennial? Or handle via priority_override only?

items.label: Cervical Cancer + HPV Co-test (Pap Smear + HPV DNA)
items._priority_rationale: Orange: standard overdue (within reasonable window). Red if overdue > 10 years (2× the 5-year co-test interval).
items.guideline: USPSTF Cervical Cancer Screening 2018 — Grade A (21–65): Pap smear alone every 3yr (ages 21–29); Pap + HPV co-test every 5yr preferred (ages 30–65); ACOG Practice Bulletin 168

items.label: DEXA Bone Density Scan — Osteoporosis Screening (2 Areas)
items.guideline: USPSTF Osteoporosis to Prevent Fractures 2018 — Grade B: women ≥ 65 routine DEXA; women < 65 if 10-year fracture risk ≥ 10% (FRAX-based)
items._expert_review_note: USPSTF has insufficient evidence for routine male screening. Should males ever receive DEXA (e.g., if on long-term steroids, or with osteoporosis risk factors)? Consider adding a separate item_code for male DEXA with risk-factor trigger if clinical team decides to include.

items.label: PSA (Prostate-Specific Antigen) — Shared Decision-Making Discussion
items._priority_rationale: Green: USPSTF C-grade (SDM, not routine recommendation) for age 55–69. ACS recommends SDM starting at 50 for average risk; earlier for high risk. Neither endorses universal screening — shared decision-making only.

navavej_product.note: OQ-10: Confirm standalone PSA product code and price with client. May be included within Diamond — Men package already.

items.guideline: ACS Prostate Cancer Early Detection 2023 — SDM at age 50 (average risk), age 40 if family_hx_prostate_ca or BRCA2; USPSTF 2018 — Grade C: SDM ages 55–69, not recommended ≥ 70
items._expert_review_note: Should age_min be 40 (not 50) when family_hx_prostate_ca is the trigger signal? ACS recommends SDM discussion starting at 40 for high-risk patients.

items.label: Diabetes Screening Pro 1 — HbA1c, Insulin, HOMA-IR (12 items)
items.guideline: ADA Standards of Medical Care 2024 — pre-diabetes monitoring: HbA1c + fasting glucose every 1–3 years depending on risk; insulin resistance assessment for obese patients

items.label: Thyroid Function Panel Pro 1 — TSH + Free T4 (6 items)
items._trigger_note: tsh_status fires when TSH is borderline or abnormal. symptom_palpitations (Option A) fires when patient reports palpitations.
items._symptom_signal_note: symptom_palpitations is an Option A signal.
items.guideline: ATA Hypothyroidism Guidelines 2014 — initial evaluation for suspected thyroid dysfunction; TSH as first-line
items._expert_review_note: Should Thyroid Pro 1 be triggered by any abnormal tsh_status, or only specific sub-signals (tsh_borderline_high, hypothyroidism_likely, hyperthyroidism_possible)? The current tsh_status signal fires for any TSH abnormality.

items.label: Thyroid Function Panel Pro 2 — TSH, Free T3, Free T4, Anti-TPO (7 items)
items.guideline: ATA 2014 — follow-up for confirmed TSH abnormality: Free T3/T4 + anti-TPO antibodies for comprehensive autoimmune thyroid evaluation

items.label: FibroTouch — Liver Fibrosis & Fat Assessment (Non-Invasive)
items.guideline: AASLD NAFLD/MASLD Practice Guidance 2023 — fibroscan/elastography for NAFLD staging when BMI ≥ 23 (Asian) + elevated ALT, or alcohol-related liver disease risk, or TG ≥ 200

items.label: Hepatitis A, B, C Viral Screening (5 items)
items._expert_review_note: hepatitis_b_vaccination_status fires for incomplete series (not started or < 2 doses). Should Hepatitis C screening (anti-HCV) have a separate trigger, e.g., for patients born 1945–1965 or with at-risk behavior? Currently bundled into the 5-item panel.

navavej_product.product_name: Hepatitis A, B, C Screening (5 items)

items.guideline: AASLD HBV Management Guidelines 2023; CDC ACIP 2022 — HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HBc, anti-HAV, anti-HCV panel

items.label: Kidney Disease Screening — Urine ACR, eGFR, Microalbumin
items.guideline: KDIGO 2022 — CKD monitoring + DM nephropathy surveillance; ADA Standards 2024 — annual urine ACR + eGFR for all DM patients

items.label: Ultrasound — Whole Abdomen (Upper + Lower)
items.guideline: AASLD 2023 — abdominal ultrasound for NAFLD/MASLD screening and alcohol-related liver disease workup; clinical practice for mildly elevated liver enzymes

items.label: Carotid Artery Ultrasound — Atherosclerosis & Stroke Risk
items.guideline: ACC/AHA 2018 Cholesterol Guideline — carotid IMT as ACC/AHA risk enhancer for reclassifying borderline-to-intermediate ASCVD risk patients
items._expert_review_note: Is age_min 50 appropriate, or should it be lower for patients with strong family_hx_premature_cad (e.g., start at 40)?

items.label: Retinal Examination — Diabetic Retinopathy Screening
items.guideline: ADA Standards of Medical Care 2024 — dilated eye exam at diagnosis, then annually (or every 1–2 years if stable and no retinopathy)

items.label: Spine MRI — Cervical or Lumbar (Office Syndrome / Chronic Back Pain)
items._priority_rationale: Green: occupational risk screening / patient-reported symptom — not an urgent clinical finding. Discretionary imaging.
items._symptom_signal_note: symptom_chronic_back_pain is an Option A signal.
items.guideline: WHO Global Plan of Action on Workers' Health 2008 — occupational MSK risk (prolonged sedentary desk work); clinical practice for chronic back pain workup

items.label: Multi-Cancer Screening (SPOT-MAS) — Blood-Based Early Multi-Cancer Detection
items._expert_review_note: SPOT-MAS is a cfDNA-based multi-cancer early detection test. Clinical evidence is emerging but not yet endorsed by USPSTF or major guidelines as a primary screening tool. Is this appropriate for recommendation to patients with family history alone? Consider limiting to patients where at least 2 of the 3 family_hx signals are active, or where conventional screening is already overdue.
items.guideline: Clinical practice — first-degree family history of hereditary cancers (CRC, breast, prostate); SPOT-MAS cfDNA multi-cancer panel (proprietary — not USPSTF-endorsed guideline)

items.label: Influenza Vaccine — Annual (Standard 3-strain, Age 1–59)
items._priority_rationale: Orange: annual vaccination gap — low burden, high preventive value. Timely completion recommended within this visit.
items.guideline: CDC ACIP Adult Immunization Schedule 2024 — annual influenza vaccination for all adults; standard dose for ages < 65
items._age_note: Age 1–59 receives standard dose. Age ≥ 60 should receive high-dose/adjuvanted (see influenza_vaccine_senior).

items.label: Influenza Vaccine — High-Dose / Adjuvanted (Age ≥ 60)
items._age_note: Mutually exclusive with influenza_vaccine by age band — MCP Server filters: patients ≥ 60 receive this item, not influenza_vaccine.
items.guideline: CDC ACIP 2024 — high-dose or MF59-adjuvanted influenza vaccine preferred for adults ≥ 65; Navavej age threshold set at 60
items._expert_review_note: ACIP prefers high-dose from ≥ 65, not ≥ 60. Confirm with hospital whether to use age 60 or 65 as the cutover point.

items.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine Series (3-dose or 2-dose Heplisav-B)
items._priority_rationale: Red if not started (0 doses). Yellow if series incomplete (1–2 doses started).

navavej_product.note: OQ: Confirm per-dose price. 3-dose series (0, 1, 6 months) or 2-dose Heplisav-B (0, 1 month). Note which is available.

items.guideline: CDC ACIP 2022 — Hepatitis B vaccination recommended for all unvaccinated adults

items.label: Pneumococcal Vaccine (PCV20 or PCV15 + PPSV23)

navavej_product.note: OQ: Confirm product code and price. PCV20 (single dose) or PCV15 + PPSV23 series — confirm which is available at Navavej.

items.guideline: CDC ACIP 2022 — PCV15 + PPSV23 or PCV20 alone (1 dose) for adults ≥ 65; also for high-risk adults < 65 (immunocompromised, asplenia, chronic illness)
items._expert_review_note: Should high-risk patients < 65 (e.g., those with active CKD, DM, or immunosuppression) also receive this recommendation? Currently age_min: 65 only.

items.label: Shingrix (RZV) — Zoster Vaccine 2-Dose Series

navavej_product.note: OQ: Confirm per-dose price. 2-dose series: Dose 1 at visit, Dose 2 at 2–6 months.

items.guideline: CDC ACIP 2017 — RZV (Shingrix) 2-dose series preferred over ZVL for all adults ≥ 50

items.label: Full Sleep Test (1-Night PSG) — Sleep Apnea Evaluation
items._expert_review_note: Is bmi_obese_asian alone sufficient to trigger sleep apnea PSG, or should it require at least one additional indicator (e.g., reported snoring from symptom_tags, or HTN as OSA comorbidity marker)?

items._expert_review_note: Should this item also be triggered by age alone (female age 45–60) as a fallback when reproductive_history questionnaire is missing? Currently only fires if questionnaire is completed and indicates perimenopausal status.
items.guideline: Clinical practice — perimenopausal hormonal assessment; ATA 2014 (thyroid function in menopause); endocrine evaluation for hormonal status
